description: Validation error - request data doesn't match serializer/schema expectations

diagnostic_steps.step: Compare frontend field names vs backend serializer
diagnostic_steps.command: Read frontend handleSubmit payload AND backend serializer fields
diagnostic_steps.rationale: Field name mismatches (camelCase vs snake_case) are #1 cause

diagnostic_steps.command: Look for fields without required=False in serializer
Read __post_init__ methods in domain value objects
diagnostic_steps.rationale: Strict domain validations may reject valid-looking data

diagnostic_steps.command: Compare frontend dropdown values vs serializer choices
diagnostic_steps.rationale: Case sensitivity and exact string matching required

common_bugs.fix: Update frontend payload to use snake_case OR add mapping in service

example.fix: Rename in either frontend or backend to match

common_bugs.cause: BankAccount requires BOTH fields if either provided
common_bugs.fix: Relax validation in __post_init__ or ensure both fields sent

common_bugs.cause: Salary value object requires non-zero amount
common_bugs.fix: Allow zero: comment out zero-check in Salary.__post_init__

common_bugs.symptom: Field validation fails on empty string
common_bugs.cause: Serializer has allow_blank=False for optional field
common_bugs.fix: Add allow_blank=True to CharField in serializer
Match exact case/format in choices list

debugging_tip: Check browser Network tab -> Request Payload to see exact data being sent
